# Source: Pelike (Storage Jar)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Pelike (Storage Jar)
- **Artist / culture:** Greek; Athens
- **Date:** about 510-500 BCE
- **Style:** greek
- **Classification:** vessel
- **Department:** Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
- **AIC artwork ID:** 158
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/158
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/48d485ec-6102-b7ec-062c-8b351055ca5f/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Dance

## Extracted source palette

`#888888, #C8C8C8, #080808, #383838, #686868, #A8A8A8, #281818, #985838`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#040404`
- `surface`: `#212121`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#985838`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#C8C8C8`
- `surface_variant`: `#212121`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#484848`
- `error`: `#985838`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `19.28:1`, surface `15.14:1`
- Variant contrast: `15.14:1`
- Control contrast: `5.21:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
